protocol.gate: Every measured sample must finish NormalForm, preserve every input payload and exactly one status per item, and verify portable replay. A failed gate blocks larger full jobs.
protocol.envelope: Native only. Framed jobs above 100 use the explicit linear-volume recording/history/replay envelope in scale_probe.rs and initial/endpoint checkpoints, not default hosted bounds. Every event is recorded and independently checked. Whole-carrier recurrence remains enabled.
protocol.comparison: B.1 failures are retained separately. The same-size 100-item cell uses the original default observation/recording limits. Larger sizes are not equal-budget speedup comparisons.
protocol.million_gate: One million requires a separately authorised graph/trace envelope after the 100k gate and a peak-RSS/trace-size projection. It is a feasibility decision, not a promised measured result.
protocol.limitations: One active label-parametric one-shot processing rule; data and rules share the carrier. This is not arbitrary reflective-body throughput or a useful public-data transformation. Phase timings overlap internal replay; no causal attribution to individual optimisations.
